equivalentSeriesResistance.explanation: Independently reviewed conservative ESR upper bound, not a direct ESR tabulation: at the same operating point ESR is the nonnegative real component of complex impedance, so ESR ≤ |Z|. The published exact-row |Z| maximum of 0.080 Ω therefore bounds ESR by 0.080 Ω at 20 °C and 100 kHz.
